opportunities.description: Global IT Sales Partner – BI, Analytics & Data Solutions International Markets | Remote Opportunity | Uncapped Commission | Performance-Based Bonuses Unleash Your Sales Potential: Flexible, Rewarding & Growth-Oriented Opportunity Are you an experienced IT sales professional with a strong business network and the ability to win international clients? Join us as a Professional IT Sales Partner and help expand our global business in IT Reporting, Business Intelligence, and Data Analytics solutions. Target Markets: USA, UK, Canada, Australia, UAE, and Europe Work Mode: 100% Remote | Flexible Hours Engagement: Commission-Based | Immediate Joining Preferred Career Opportunity: Potential Transition to Permanent Employment What You'll Sell: - Power BI and Tableau dashboards and BI solutions - MIS reporting and management dashboards - Data analytics and business intelligence services - Reporting automation solutions - Data engineering and data integration services Why Partner With Us? - Uncapped Earning Potential: Earn commissions of up to 20%, plus performance bonuses of up to $1,000 for qualifying high-value sales exceeding $80,000. - Career Growth: High-performing partners may qualify for permanent employment with a fixed salary and additional incentives from Month 2 onwards, subject to performance and mutual agreement. - Flexible Remote Work: Work independently, manage your schedule, and develop business across international markets. - Long-Term Partnership: Build valuable client relationships and grow with our business. Roles & Responsibility: - Identify and acquire new international clients for our IT services. - Generate qualified leads and develop a strong sales pipeline. - Leverage your professional network and industry relationships to reach decision-makers. - Build relationships with business owners, senior executives, and technology leaders. - Understand client requirements and coordinate with our technical team to develop suitable proposals. - Manage negotiations, follow-ups, and deal closures. - Develop long-term client relationships and generate repeat business. Qualifications - 5–7 years of experience in business development or sales, preferably in IT services, BI, reporting, or data analytics. - Proven ability to generate leads, acquire clients, and close B2B deals. - Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-management skills. - Experience targeting international clients, particularly in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, UAE, or Europe. - An independent, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to develop business opportunities from scratch. Commission Structure & Performance Incentives *1. Sales up to $25,000 - 8% commission on eligible project value. - Additional 10% performance incentive for surpassing agreed sales targets. *2. Sales from $25,001 to $80,000 - 10% commission on eligible project value. - Additional $250 bonus for qualifying sales. *3. Sales exceeding $80,000 - Enhanced commission incentives of up to 20%, subject to the agreed compensation terms. - Performance bonuses of up to $1,000 for qualifying high-value sales. - Additional annual milestone rewards may be discussed and agreed upon based on performance. *# Commission rates, performance targets, bonus eligibility, and payment terms will be agreed upon in writing before the engagement begins.#* #Payment Terms: - Commission-Based Compensation: This is a commission-only opportunity during the initial engagement, with no guaranteed monthly salary, advance payment, or upfront fees for lead generation or setup. - Commission Calculation: Commissions will be calculated on eligible project revenue actually received by the company, excluding applicable taxes and refunds. - Payment Schedule: Commissions will generally be processed within 5–7 business days after the corresponding client payment has been received and cleared. - Performance Bonuses: Eligible performance bonuses will be paid according to the agreed criteria and payment schedule. - Sales Attribution: The written agreement will define how leads, jointly managed opportunities, closed deals, and repeat business are attributed to the sales partner. - Payment Method: Payments will be made through a mutually agreed, legally compliant payment method. - Written Agreement: All commission rates, payment timelines, bonus conditions, and other relevant terms will be documented and agreed upon before the engagement begins. #Ready to Build Your International Sales Success? If you have the experience, industry connections, and drive to acquire international IT services clients, we would love to hear from you. *Apply now to become our Professional IT Sales Partner and turn your sales expertise into a rewarding global opportunity!*

Adjustable Chin Support: Design a telescopic adjustment mechanism with a secure locking system to ensure stability and proper positioning. 2. Pillow Connection: Complete the mechanical connection between the neck pillow and the plug/connector. 3. Structural Improvements: Refine the existing design to ensure functionality, durability, and manufacturability. 4. Final Deliverables: * Editable 3D CAD files and STEP files. * Detailed engineering drawings. * Exploded assembly view, where appropriate. * Basic CMF specifications (color, material, and finish). Requirements: * Experience in mechanical engineering and consumer product development. * Experience designing adjustable and locking mechanisms. * Portfolio demonstrating functional mechanical products. I prefer to improve the existing design rather than redesign the entire product. Please include all deliverables and revisions in your quote and identify any potential additional costs upfront.

opportunities.title: Realistic AI Video: Dreadlock Removal
opportunities.description: I’m building a virtual salon that feels as real and welcoming as a cozy home studio lit by soft daylight. For this first asset I need a hyper-realistic AI-generated video focusing on a single Black female client seated comfortably while her dreadlocks are taken down, step by deliberate step. Key visual flow • Continuous close-ups of the stylist’s hands carefully undoing each lock. • Natural hand-to-hair interaction—no clipping, ghosting, or sudden “popping” artifacts. • Camera work that maintains intimacy: shallow depth of field, gentle camera pans, true-to-life textures in skin, hair, clothing, and background décor. • Environment: warm wooden floors, indoor plants, simple shelving with natural-light spill from a nearby window to reinforce the home-based vibe. Technical expectations • Final output in 4K (or highest native resolution your pipeline allows) with 24 – 30 fps playback. • Physically-based shading for both hair and skin; realistic strand behavior as the locks are loosened. • Seamless loop or clean in/out points so the clip can be edited into larger salon sequences later. Acceptance criteria 1. Every lock removal motion is complete—no skipped frames or disappearing sections of hair. 2. Hands, combs, and accessories maintain proper collision with the hair mesh throughout. 3. Lighting stays consistent to match natural daylight; no artificial color shifts. opportunities.title: Character Illustration for E-Commerce
opportunities.description: I need a striking digital illustration—think vivid, personality-packed character or portrait art—that will become the visual anchor for my brand, “EptaEptaEptaEpta.” The piece will be used across our store front, packaging, and promotional spots, so it must instantly communicate quality and make buyers feel they’re engaging with something special. My priorities: strong concept development, a polished final render, and files ready for both print and web. Feel free to work in Procreate, Photoshop, Clip Studio, or any tool you prefer, as long as I receive layered source files and export-ready PNGs/JPGs. Deliverables • One fully rendered character or portrait illustration in RGB (3000 px + wide) • CMYK version prepared for print (300 dpi) • Layered source file (PSD or equivalent) I’ll supply style references, brand colours, and a short creative brief once we kick off. If you have a portfolio showing expressive character work that has already helped products sell—especially illustrations with clean silhouettes and eye-catching colour—please share it when you bid.

opportunities.title: 【招標需求】高端跨國律師樓風格——雙語 WordPress 網站設計與開發（要求先出 設計稿(可以Figma) ）
opportunities.description: 【招標需求】高端跨國律師樓風格——雙語 WordPress 網站設計與開發（要求先出 設計稿(可以Figma) ） 1.項目概述 我們是一家總部位於香港的頂級國際調查顧問中心（Domain: ）。現需打造一個全新、極致權威、高信譽且具現代感的官方網站。網站風格需參考頂級跨國律師事務所（如 Deacons、Mayer Brown）及 Apple/ Stripe官網，採用 Luxury, Classic, Modern 的設計語言，主色調以 Apple 式極簡白底為主，搭配光澤金、可以點綴的紅色，深藍/黑色及高質感留白。 【特別說明】：本網站最終面向香港及國際客戶，前端呈現語言必須為繁體中文（ZH-HK）與英文（EN）雙語。 2. 核心招標條件（請仔細閱讀） 語言能力： 必須能使用流利中文（繁體/簡體均可）進行溝通，且英文閱讀與書寫能力優良（網站需做中英雙語）。 溝通效率： 必須能夠通過 WhatsApp 進行及時溝通，訊息回復速度快。 開發流程： 【必須先出 設計稿（可以選擇Figma）】，經我們審核及修改確認視覺風格後，方可進入 WordPress 建站開發。 設計能力： 設計功底紮實，擅長動態視覺（如數字跳動、走馬燈、圖表視覺化），可接受配合 AI 工具輔助繪圖。能自行搭配給予專業設計意見。 4. SEO 與效能硬性指標 (SEO & Performance KPIs) —— 【核心交付標準】 網站底層架構必須符合標準 SEO 規範（Clean Code, H1-H3 標籤階層, Schema 結構化數據, Sitemap 自動生成）。 網站加載速度： 經由 Google PageSpeed Insights 測試，電腦版得分須 90 分以上，手機版得分須 75 分以上。 SEO 外掛設定： 安裝並設定好 Rank Math SEO (或 Yoast)，自動生成 XML Sitemap 並提交至 Google Search Console。 基礎技術 SEO 規範： a. 全站圖片必須自動壓縮並轉換為 WebP 格式。 b. 頁面須支援 H1, H2, H3 標籤階層，支援 Canonical Tags 及 Open Graph 社交分享標籤。 c. 所有標題 (Meta Title) 及描述 (Meta Description) 欄位需開放可自由修改。 d. 安全與權限： 配置基礎安全防護外掛（如 Wordfence），全站安裝 SSL 證書（HTTPS）。 5. 項目規模與頁面數量 (Page Count & Features) 6. 預估頁面總數： 暫時估計 15 - 24 個頁面（包含首頁、關於我們、警察團隊與認證、FAQ、聯絡我們，以及 14 個專業調查服務子頁面，另含文章與案例系統 Template）。 開發模式： 為控制成本，乙方需交付 8 個核心主頁面及 Template 範本（包含首頁、關於我們、員警團隊與認證、FAQ/流程、聯繫我們、3 個核心服務分類 Template，以及文章/案例 Template），以便甲方後續自行複製拓展子頁面. 7. 網站主要功能要求： 雙語系統： WPML 或 Polylang 實現繁體中文 (ZH-HK) 與英文 (EN) 無縫切換。 首頁多模組： 2-3 張高質感 Banner 設計輪播、信任背書走馬燈 (WAD/IKD Badge)、動態數字跳動 (Our Strength)、服務卡片輪播、影片區塊、客戶好評走馬燈。 互動功能： 頁首/頁尾與內頁放置「3-Step 多步驟動態保密諮詢表單」、右下角 WhatsApp 懸浮對話框、頁尾世界地圖與可伸縮全球辦事處地址列、文章社交媒體分享按鈕 (FB, LinkedIn, WhatsApp)。 金流整合報價： 頁尾需展示 PayMe, FPS, Visa, Master, PayPal 等圖示。（請在報價中單獨列出「若需對接 Visa/Master/Stripe/PayPal 線上金流刷卡功能」的額外費用）。 8. 技術與效能指標 (KPIs) 建站工具： 必須使用 WordPress + Elementor Pro 搭建，全站每個 Section 需可獨立新增、刪除或隱藏。 加載速度： 經 Google PageSpeed Insights 測試，電腦版得分須達 90+，手機版須達 75+（圖片自動轉 WebP 並壓縮）。 RWD 響應式： 完美適配 iOS / Android 手機及平板電腦。 9. 交付物與售後 (Deliverables) 完整測試網址 (Staging Area) 驗收確認後，移交至業主指定的 Hostinger / Cloudways 主機。 交付所有最高管理員權限 (Administrator Passwords)。 提供 1-2 小時後台內容上架與修改的操作指導影片或線上培訓。(中文或者國語都可以） 10. 預算與工期要求 開發工期： 建議在 14 - 21 天內 完成（含 設計出稿審核 5 天，WordPress 開發 10 天，測試驗收 3-5 天）。 開發預算： 歡迎高性價比個人 Freelancers 或工作室報價（預算範圍：美元$250 - 450 美元，請給出最具競爭力且合理的價格）。 6. 應徵方式（投遞時請提供）： 1. 請附上過往製作過的 WordPress 網站作品集（Portfolios），特別是律師樓、金融、高端諮詢或雙語網站範例。 2. 請確認是否能使用 WhatsApp 及時迅速溝通 並同意 「先出 （Figma） 設計稿再建站」 的流程。 3. 請給出您的最終報價及最快可交付工期。

SEO 與效能硬性指標 (SEO & Performance KPIs) —— 【核心交付標準】 網站底層架構必須符合標準 SEO 規範（Clean Code, H1-H3 標籤階層, Schema 結構化數據, Sitemap 自動生成）。 網站加載速度： 經由 Google PageSpeed Insights 測試，電腦版得分須 90 分以上，手機版得分須 75 分以上。 SEO 外掛設定： 安裝並設定好 Rank Math SEO (或 Yoast)，自動生成 XML Sitemap 並提交至 Google Search Console。 基礎技術 SEO 規範： a. 全站圖片必須自動壓縮並轉換為 WebP 格式。 b. 頁面須支援 H1, H2, H3 標籤階層，支援 Canonical Tags 及 Open Graph 社交分享標籤。 c. 所有標題 (Meta Title) 及描述 (Meta Description) 欄位需開放可自由修改。 d. 安全與權限： 配置基礎安全防護外掛（如 Wordfence），全站安裝 SSL 證書（HTTPS）。 5. 項目規模與頁面數量 (Page Count & Features) 6. 預估頁面總數： 暫時估計 15 - 24 個頁面（包含首頁、關於我們、警察團隊與認證、FAQ、聯絡我們，以及 14 個專業調查服務子頁面，另含文章與案例系統 Template）。 開發模式： 為控制成本，乙方需交付 8 個核心主頁面及 Template 範本（包含首頁、關於我們、員警團隊與認證、FAQ/流程、聯繫我們、3 個核心服務分類 Template，以及文章/案例 Template），以便甲方後續自行複製拓展子頁面. 7. 網站主要功能要求： 雙語系統： WPML 或 Polylang 實現繁體中文 (ZH-HK) 與英文 (EN) 無縫切換。 首頁多模組： 2-3 張高質感 Banner 設計輪播、信任背書走馬燈 (WAD/IKD Badge)、動態數字跳動 (Our Strength)、服務卡片輪播、影片區塊、客戶好評走馬燈。 互動功能： 頁首/頁尾與內頁放置「3-Step 多步驟動態保密諮詢表單」、右下角 WhatsApp 懸浮對話框、頁尾世界地圖與可伸縮全球辦事處地址列、文章社交媒體分享按鈕 (FB, LinkedIn, WhatsApp)。 金流整合報價： 頁尾需展示 PayMe, FPS, Visa, Master, PayPal 等圖示。（請在報價中單獨列出「若需對接 Visa/Master/Stripe/PayPal 線上金流刷卡功能」的額外費用）。 8. 技術與效能指標 (KPIs) 建站工具： 必須使用 WordPress + Elementor Pro 搭建，全站每個 Section 需可獨立新增、刪除或隱藏。 加載速度： 經 Google PageSpeed Insights 測試，電腦版得分須達 90+，手機版須達 75+（圖片自動轉 WebP 並壓縮）。 RWD 響應式： 完美適配 iOS / Android 手機及平板電腦。 9. 交付物與售後 (Deliverables) 完整測試網址 (Staging Area) 驗收確認後，移交至業主指定的 Hostinger / Cloudways 主機。 交付所有最高管理員權限 (Administrator Passwords)。 提供 1-2 小時後台內容上架與修改的操作指導影片或線上培訓。(中文或者國語都可以） 10. 預算與工期要求 開發工期： 建議在 14 - 21 天內 完成（含 設計出稿審核 5 天，WordPress 開發 10 天，測試驗收 3-5 天）。 開發預算： 歡迎高性價比個人 Freelancers 或工作室報價（預算範圍：美元$250 - 450 美元，請給出最具競爭力且合理的價格）。 6. 應徵方式（投遞時請提供）： 1. 請附上過往製作過的 WordPress 網站作品集（Portfolios），特別是律師樓、金融、高端諮詢或雙語網站範例。 2. 請確認是否能使用 WhatsApp 及時迅速溝通 並同意 「先出 （Figma） 設計稿再建站」 的流程。 3. 請給出您的最終報價及最快可交付工期。"

proposal.subject: Propuesta Directa: 【招標需求】高端跨國律師樓風格——雙語 WordPress 網站設計與開發（要求先出 設計稿(可以Figma) ）
proposal.body:

opportunities.title: Full Business Website & Hosting
opportunities.description: I want a clean, modern website that presents my business and services clearly and professionally. The site’s primary role is informational, but it still needs to feel engaging and credible to visitors. I’ll need the standard public-facing pages—Home, About Us, Services, a Contact page that includes a Google Map with an enquiry form, plus a section where I can showcase photos, client testimonials, and a concise FAQ. All hosting and technical setup should be handled for me, including domain connection, SSL, and basic security hardening so the site is live and worry-free from day one. Because I don’t yet have any branded assets, part of this project is helping me create a cohesive visual identity: a simple logo, compelling copy for each page, and a small set of on-brand images. If you have an in-house designer or photographer, or can source quality stock photos, let me know how you plan to cover that. Please outline: • Your recommended platform or stack (WordPress, Webflow, custom HTML, etc.) and why it fits an information-driven site • Estimated timeline from kick-off to launch, including content creation • What kind of post-launch support or training you provide so I can update text or images myself I’ll consider the project complete once the site is live on its own hosting, the pages render correctly on desktop and mobile, the enquiry form delivers to my inbox, and all content and branding pieces look consistent.

opportunities.title: Stoic homecare
opportunities.description: Job Title: Google Ads Expert for Local Service Lead Generation (Strict Budget Control & Zero Wasted Spend) Job Description: We run a local home care service based in Delhi-NCR and need a no-nonsense, highly experienced Google Ads freelancer to take complete control of our Search campaigns. We do not need theoretical marketers, agency middlemen, or people who rely blindly on automated Smart Bidding. We need someone who understands hyper-local search intent, auction dynamics, tight bid caps, and how to protect ad budget from leaking into useless clicks. Current Situation & Scope: * Ad Spend: ₹40,000 – ₹60,000 monthly test budget (to be scaled based on CPA and ROI). * Goal: Generate direct, genuine inbound phone calls and WhatsApp inquiries from families seeking home patient care. * Problem to Solve: We are getting irrelevant traffic, job seekers clicking on ads, and sudden spikes where daily budget gets exhausted in a few accidental clicks. Key Responsibilities: * Zero Budget Leakage Setup: Complete restructuring using tightly controlled Exact and high-intent Phrase match keywords. * Aggressive Negative Keyword Sculpting: Build and maintain an exhaustive negative keyword list from Day 1 to strictly block job inquiries, free searches, and unrelated medical queries. * Bid Protection: Set up Manual CPC or Maximize Clicks with strict Max CPC bid limits to ensure no single click drains the daily budget. * Conversion & Call Tracking: Verify that call assets, on-site call tracking, and WhatsApp conversion triggers are firing accurately. * Daily Monitoring: Review Search Terms daily for the first two weeks and eliminate non-converting queries immediately. Requirements: * Proven track record running Google Search Ads for local Indian services (healthcare, home care, rentals, or emergency home services). * Clear understanding of why broad match and unguided Smart Bidding fail on new, low-budget local accounts. * Upwork Job Success Score (JSS) 90%+ with verifiable past local lead gen results. * Available for a 10-minute screen-share technical discussion where you will be shown our live search terms report and asked to identify budget waste on the spot. How to Apply: Do not paste generic cover letters or agency pitch decks. Start your proposal with the word "AUDIT" and answer these two specific questions: * Which 3 settings do you immediately apply to stop an ad from draining ₹800–₹1,000 in just 2 to 3 accidental clicks? * Mention one local Indian lead generation campaign you personally handled and what average CPC/CPA you achieved. Proposals without direct answers to these questions will be declined immediately.

opportunities.title: Android App User Feedback
opportunities.description: Android App Feedback – No Technical Skills Needed We are developing a new Android application and looking for everyday smartphone users to try it and share their honest feedback. No technical experience, programming knowledge, or professional software testing skills are required. We particularly welcome people who normally use their smartphones for activities such as WhatsApp, Instagram, photography, shopping, watching videos, and everyday communication. Our application is a file manager with additional personal features, including: - File and folder management. - Private photo and video gallery. - Private Browser - Personal journal and notes. - Calendar and reminders. - Cloud storage. - Access through a web browser. We want to understand how ordinary people experience our application before its wider launch. How to Participate To participate, submit a proposal through Freelancer. Selected freelancers will receive an Android application testing link through Freelancer.com's messaging system. After using the application for at least seven days, submit your PDF feedback report through Freelancer. Your feedback should cover: - What was your first impression? - Was the application easy to understand? - Which features did you find useful? - What confused or frustrated you? - Did you encounter any bugs or unexpected behaviour? - What would you improve? - Would you continue using the app? - Would you consider paying for additional cloud storage? Why or why not? Screenshots are welcome but not mandatory. Who Can Join? - Anyone with an Android smartphone. - Beginners and first-time freelancers are welcome. - No professional testing experience is needed. - Basic written English is sufficient. - Different phone brands and Android versions are welcome. We value honest, natural feedback more than polished professional reports. Negative feedback is equally valuable. Participants will not be rewarded for praising the application or penalised for identifying problems. This project is for private product feedback only. We are not requesting or rewarding Google Play ratings, public reviews, social media posts, or promotional content. We look forward to hearing how real users experience our application.

opportunities.title: Commission-Based SMB Consulting Sales
opportunities.description: I run a company that helps small businesses tighten their operations, weave practical AI into everyday workflows, and keep their accounting clean and insightful. I’m ready to pay generously—on a pure commission model—for someone who can bring these owners to the table and close the deal. You’ll focus exclusively on the small-business segment, uncovering pain points around processes, automation and financial clarity, then positioning our business-consulting packages as the fix. Marketing strategy or broad “growth advice” is not the priority here; we specialize in operations & process improvement, AI consulting and accounting support, and that is exactly what you will be selling. Feel free to leverage your own network, LinkedIn outreach, local meet-ups—whatever consistently delivers decision-makers with fewer than 50 employees who are ready for hands-on help. Geography is flexible; English-speaking clients are all that’s required. Deliverables • Warm, qualified leads willing to take a discovery call • Signed consulting agreements—commission released once payment clears • Concise handover notes so our delivery team can begin immediately Acceptance Criteria • two new signed clients within the first 30 days or a demonstrably full pipeline of equivalent value If you thrive on commission-only arrangements and know how to speak the language of small-business owners, let’s get started.

opportunities.title: 3D Yacht Model Creation
opportunities.description: I need a 3D model of a yacht's outer hull and deck using Rhino or similar software. The model will serve as a visual and dimensional reference to consider various possible designs for an enclosure to be built over the forward cockpit. The yacht is a Swan 90, Flush deck version, built in 2008. Requirements: - Use 2D drawings and images as basis - Very close dimensions to 2D drawings for design review Ideal Skills: - Proficiency in Rhino or equivalent 3D modeling software - Experience in marine design or yacht modeling - Attention to detail for accurate dimensioning Please provide samples of similar work. Here is a link to a brochure which shows 2D plan view and side view of the flush deck version. also attached are some photos and by very rough sketch of the are on the yacht where the enclosure will be located; https://pdf.nauticexpo.com/viewerCatalog/nautor-swan/swan-90/20326-47641.html#open This quote is only to supply the accurate 3D model of the existing boat, not to undertake design work of the new enclosure. The model needs to be supplied in a format that can be used to draw possible designs of the future enclosure and obtain accurate dimensional information of those.

opportunities.title: Animation 3D pose fenêtres chantier à diffuser sur le site web et YouTube
opportunities.description: Je cherche à faire réaliser une animation 3D hyper-réaliste qui montre, directement sur un chantier virtuel, notre méthode complète de pose de fenêtres avec cales d’installation. La vidéo devra suivre le déroulé réel : préparation de l’ouverture, positionnement précis des cales, mise en place de la menuiserie, fixation puis finitions. Les points clés à mettre en avant sont : • Les cales d’installation et leur emplacement exact à chaque étape. • Les différentes séquences de pose expliquées à l’écran par de courts titrages ou infographies intégrées. • Les outils utilisés et les gestes des installateurs, reproduits de façon crédible. Je souhaite un rendu photoréaliste, aussi proche que possible d’une captation vidéo : textures chantier, éclairages naturels, mouvements de caméra fluides. Un ton pédagogique clair est indispensable, la vidéo étant destinée à former nos équipes terrain et à convaincre des partenaires. Livrables attendus : • Story-board validé avant production. • Animation finale 60-90 s minimum en Full HD (format .mp4), prête à diffuser. • Fichiers source du projet (Blender, 3ds Max, Cinema 4D ou équivalent) pour d’éventuelles mises à jour internes. • Fichiers texte des titrages / sous-titres pour traduction ultérieure. Merci d’indiquer votre approche technique, les logiciels utilisés et des exemples de travaux comparables afin que je puisse évaluer rapidité, réalisme et sens du détail.

opportunities.title: Lightweight Unity Roulette Game Development
opportunities.description: Unity Game Developer Required – Lightweight Full HD Roulette Game Project Type: Freelance / Contract Required Skill: Unity Game Development (2D/3D) Platform: Android / Web (HTML5/WebGL) Graphics Quality: Full HD (1080p) Project Overview We are looking for an experienced Unity Game Developer to develop a high-quality, lightweight roulette game with smooth animations and attractive Full HD graphics. The game should deliver an excellent visual experience while maintaining optimized performance on low- to mid-range devices. Key Requirements - Develop a roulette game using Unity. - Create an attractive, professional casino-style UI. - Implement smooth roulette wheel spinning animations. - Optimize graphics and performance for low-end devices. - Ensure responsive UI across different screen sizes. - Optimize loading time, memory usage, and CPU consumption. - Implement clean, modular, and maintainable code. - Support Android and/or WebGL deployment. - Provide complete source code and project files. Graphics & Performance - Full HD 1920 × 1080 visual quality. - Smooth animations and transitions. - Lightweight assets and optimized textures. - Realistic 3D wheel or high-quality 2D wheel, depending on the proposed solution. - Stable performance on compatible low- and mid-range devices. Required Skills - Strong experience with Unity and C#. - Experience developing casino-style or roulette games. - Knowledge of 2D/3D animation and UI/UX implementation. - Experience with performance optimization. - Familiarity with Android builds and/or WebGL deployment. - Ability to deliver clean, documented source code. How to Apply Please include the following in your proposal: 1. Your previous Unity game development projects. 2. Links to your portfolio or playable demos. 3. Your recommended technology and development approach. 4. Estimated development timeline. 5. Your total project cost. 6. Confirmation that you will provide complete source code. Preference: Developers with previous experience building lightweight, visually polished casino-style games. We are looking for a reliable developer who can deliver a professional, optimized, and visually impressive roulette game. Please apply with your portfolio, estimated budget, and delivery timeline.

opportunities.title: Warehouse Floor Plan Drafting
opportunities.description: The space is a rectangular warehouse measuring 41 ft by 27 ft. I need a clean, professional drawing that shows exactly how the interior will be laid out. The assignment is for a simple floor plan only—no structural or permit-level detail—just an accurate, to-scale view that clearly identifies the 15 racks, two doors, and a small mechanical area. I will provide a rough hand sketch that explains how I’d like the racks arranged; you can follow that layout directly. Please include the following elements in the finished file: • Overall building outline with dimensions (41 ft × 27 ft) • Precise location and size of each rack, both doors, and the mechanical area • Individual measurements called out for every rack, door, and the mechanical space • Labels for each rack (Rack 1, Rack 2, etc.) plus clearly marked walking paths between rows A scaled PDF is essential. If you create the plan in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Revit, or similar software, a native editable file would be appreciated as well.

opportunities.title: WordPress Expansion & Marketing Setup
opportunities.description: I need help rolling out a full-scale upgrade to my existing WordPress site and its marketing stack. The very first milestone is to create new service pages—one for every service I offer—complete with clear service details and benefits. Each of these pages has to plug neatly into my current theme, follow our existing design language, and save incoming enquiries to the database so we can track leads later. Once the pages are live and indexed, the project widens to on-page SEO, WhatsApp automation tied into a lightweight CRM, and finally regular Facebook ad posting aimed at driving traffic back to the new pages. I am keeping the quoted price fixed from the outset, so please bid only if you are comfortable delivering everything within that figure. Core deliverables • Build and style dedicated service pages • Populate each page with compelling service details & benefits (content is ready to supply) • Hook enquiry forms to the site’s database for lead capture • Apply basic on-page SEO to the new pages so they rank quickly • After pages are approved: connect WhatsApp automation to a CRM of your choice (open to suggestions) • Schedule and publish targeted Facebook ads that point to the new pages Acceptance criteria 1. Pages render flawlessly on desktop and mobile and pass a Lighthouse score of 90+. 2. Form submissions are recorded in the database and trigger a WhatsApp notification via the CRM. 3. Initial SEO audit shows no critical issues on the new pages. 4. First set of Facebook ads goes live with correct targeting and tracking pixels in place. If you have solid WordPress, SEO, automation, and Facebook Ads experience—and you’re happy to stick to the agreed price—I’m ready to get started right away.

opportunities.title: Travel Doc Edit and 3D Animation (kannada)
opportunities.description: I’m piecing together a documentary-style video built around travel and social-event footage that I’ll supply. Because I captured the trip on the fly, I have little to no usable B-roll; instead, I want those visual gaps filled with original 3D animated sequences starring stylised people and characters that reinforce the narrative moments I call out in the script. Here is what I need from you: • A tightly-cut documentary edit that keeps the energy of the journey, balances interviews with natural sound, and flows logically from opening to close. • Bespoke 3D animated inserts (people-focused, not environments) that illustrate key anecdotes, run roughly 5–20 seconds each, and blend seamlessly with the live footage in both pacing and colour mood. • Clean colour grade, audio mix, and any essential captions or lower-thirds so the final piece is publication-ready in 4K and a social-media-friendly 1080p version. I’ll provide: raw video files, a rough storyboard indicating where animation should appear, a temp VO track, and music licenses. Acceptance criteria: final timeline delivered in Premiere Pro (or DaVinci Resolve if preferred) with all media relinked; exported masters matching the specs above; separate folder containing the original 3D animation renders with alpha if composited externally. If you’re comfortable blending travel documentary editing with character-driven 3D animation, let’s talk timing and milestones.

opportunities.title: Kannada Temple Documentary Editor
opportunities.description: I have several hours of 4K footage captured in and around Karnataka’s ancient temples and related heritage sites. The vision is a cinematic, documentary-style Kannada film that blends live-action material with carefully integrated 3D animation. The storyline centres on temples and the historical events connected to them. To make this engaging, I want two specific kinds of animation sequences woven into the edit: • Re-creations of key historical events and characters that a camera could never capture today. • Animated maps and site layouts that guide the viewer through each location and illustrate our travel path between shrines. All narration, on-screen titles and lower-thirds must be in Kannada; background score should enhance the devotional mood without overpowering interviews or ambience. Good colour work, clean dialogue edits, and cinematic sound design (atmospheric chants, bells, birds, crowd beds) are important. Deliverables • Locked picture in 4K (ProRes or DNx) with mixed audio • Separate dialogue, music and effects stems • Mastered final export (H.264) ready for YouTube and festival submission • A 60-second trailer highlighting both live footage and your 3D sequences If you already edit in DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro or similar and can manage the full pipeline—from rough cut to final grade and audio mix—let’s discuss timelines and any assets you need from my side.

opportunities.title: Travel Documentary Editor + 3D (Kannada)
opportunities.description: I'm putting together a travel-focused documentary that explores culture and social issues, but I don’t have the usual B-roll. Instead, I want key moments recreated through 3D animation—full scenes that bring past events and locations to life when real footage isn’t available. You’ll take the material I supply (voice-over, primary interviews, and any reference photos) and shape it into a coherent, engaging film. That means structuring the narrative, pacing it with documentary-style rhythm, adding titles and lower thirds, balancing audio, colour-grading, and compositing the 3D sequences so they feel seamless next to the live-action segments. For the 3D work, I’m picturing realistic environments that match the era and setting we discuss, but I’m open to your creative approach as long as it clearly tells the story. Blender, Cinema 4D, or similar tools are fine—use what you’re fastest with. Premiere Pro / DaVinci Resolve for the edit and After Effects for any motion graphics would keep the workflow smooth, but again, I’ll follow your lead if you have a more efficient pipeline. Deliverables • A rough cut for early feedback • A final 1080p (preferably 4K) master with integrated 3D reconstructions and polished sound mix • Separate 3D renders or project files in case I need tweaks later I’m available for quick turnarounds on notes, and I value clear communication throughout. Let me know your experience with documentary pacing and any samples where you blended live action with 3D storytelling.

opportunities.title: AI Marketplace MVP Developer
opportunities.description: KAAMLYY is an India-focused, AI-assisted marketplace that brings multiple service categories under one roof. The first milestone is a 30-day MVP that lets customers open a single mobile app, browse any available category, place items from different services in one cart, and check out. At payment they must be able to choose between paying online up-front or settling directly with the professional after the job. Scope of build • Architecture & tech stack selection (modern JS/TS, Node or similar, React Native or Flutter, PostgreSQL / Mongo, REST + GraphQL). • Responsive customer app (iOS, Android, PWA) with unified catalogue, smart search and AI-driven service matching. • Companion web portal for service professionals to accept, schedule and track jobs. • Admin dashboard for onboarding, category management, dispute handling, analytics and role-based permissions. • Secure payment gateway integration supporting both online and post-service options, plus wallet/refund handling. • Scalable API layer, database schema, and cloud deployment pipeline (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD). • Basic AI layer: prompt-based assistance for search, automatic job-to-pro match scoring and conversational help bot. • Unit, integration and E2E tests, plus clear technical and user documentation. Acceptance criteria 1. A user can install the app, select services from at least two categories, add them to one cart and confirm the booking. 2. Both payment flows work and trigger status updates for customer and professional. 3. Admin can view every transaction, manually override status, and pull exportable reports. 4. Code passes automated tests in the pipeline and deploys to a staging URL and TestFlight/Play console without manual fixes. Solo freelancers only—no agencies. Comfort with Copilot / ChatGPT-assisted coding is essential; speed matters, but not at the expense of clean, secure, review-ready code.

opportunities.title: Commission-Based IT Client Acquisition Partner
opportunities.description: # Hiring: Freelance IT Business Development Partner (Commission-Based) We are looking for a motivated **freelance business development partner** who can help us acquire new clients for our IT services. **Work Mode:** Remote **Job Type:** Freelance / Independent Contractor **Compensation:** Commission-Based — No Fixed Salary ### Services We Offer - Website and Web Application Development - Mobile App Development - Custom Software Development - AI Agents and Business Automation - Cloud Solutions and AWS Services ### Responsibilities - Find potential clients through LinkedIn and other professional channels. - Connect with business owners, startup founders, CEOs, CTOs, and decision-makers. - Identify businesses that need IT solutions and software development services. - Generate qualified leads, build client relationships, and convert prospects into paying customers. - Coordinate with our team to understand client requirements and close projects. ### Who We're Looking For - Freelancers with experience in B2B sales, IT business development, or lead generation. - Strong communication, negotiation, and client relationship skills. - Experience acquiring clients for software development companies or digital agencies is a plus. - Existing connections with international clients are an advantage. - Self-motivated professionals who focus on results rather than just generating leads. ### Commission Structure - Attractive commission on successfully acquired client projects. - Commission percentage and payment terms will be mutually agreed upon before starting. - Opportunity for a long-term partnership with recurring earning potential. **Important:** This is a commission-only freelance opportunity. There is no fixed monthly salary. ### Interested? Send us a message with: - Your relevant experience. - Your approach to acquiring IT clients. - The markets or industries you specialize in. - Any previous client acquisition results. Let's build a mutually beneficial partnership and grow together!

opportunities.title: Employee Records & Payroll Policies
opportunities.description: Part-Time HR & Payroll Specialist – Healthcare / Multi-Location Business Job Type: Part-Time | Remote | Ongoing Industry: Healthcare / Optometry Location: U.S. HR and payroll experience required About Us We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented HR professional to help streamline and manage our human resources operations, including recruitment, employee onboarding, time and attendance, HRIS administration, and payroll coordination for our multi-location optometry offices . We are looking for someone who can establish efficient processes, ensure accuracy and compliance, and work closely with our leadership team. Key Responsibilities 1. Recruitment & Hiring Post and manage job openings across Indeed and other hiring platforms. Source and screen candidates for clinical, administrative, and management positions. Coordinate interviews, reference checks, offer letters, and onboarding. Maintain an organized recruitment pipeline and hiring tracker. 2. HRIS & Employee Management Manage and maintain our HRIS platform. Maintain accurate employee records, employment documents, and personnel files. Oversee new-hire onboarding and employee offboarding. Track employee status changes, compensation updates, and benefits eligibility. 3. Time, Attendance & PTO Monitor employee timekeeping, attendance, tardiness, and absences. Review timecards for accuracy and identify discrepancies. Administer PTO, sick leave, and attendance policies. Provide attendance and overtime reports to management. Help establish accountability and consistent attendance procedures across locations. 4. Payroll Administration Review and prepare payroll data for processing. Verify hours, overtime, PTO, bonuses, and payroll adjustments. Coordinate with our payroll provider to ensure accurate, timely payroll. Identify payroll discrepancies and recommend improvements. 5. HR Compliance & Process Improvement Assist with compliance with federal, Illinois, and Chicago employment regulations. Maintain employee handbooks, policies, and HR documentation. Help implement standardized HR procedures across all offices. Create HR dashboards and reports for management. Recommend automation and process improvements to reduce administrative workload. Qualifications Minimum 3–5 years of experience in U.S. HR administration, payroll, and recruitment. Strong experience with HRIS and payroll systems. Familiarity with Illinois employment laws, PTO, sick leave, overtime, and timekeeping requirements. Experience with multi-location healthcare practices or small-to-medium-sized businesses preferred. Proficiency in Excel, Google Sheets, and recruiting platforms. Highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and dependable. Excellent communication skills and ability to maintain confidentiality. Ideal Candidate We are seeking someone who is not simply an administrative assistant, but an experienced HR professional who can independently manage HR workflows, identify problems, implement solutions, and hold processes to consistent standards. This is an ongoing opportunity with potential to expand responsibilities as our organization grows. To Apply Please include: Your experience managing HR for U.S.-based companies. Which HRIS and payroll systems you have used. Your experience with recruitment and employee attendance management. Your familiarity with Illinois employment regulations. Your hourly rate and weekly availability. Examples of HR processes or systems you have implemented or improved. We are particularly interested in candidates who can help us build a streamlined, efficient, and accountable HR operation.

opportunities.title: High-Finish Prototype 3D Print
opportunities.description: I have a completed STL/STEP file and need it printed exactly to scale for a display model. Visual quality is key: the surface must be smooth enough that a quick pass with fine sandpaper lets me move straight to paint. FDM or resin is acceptable—choose the process you feel gives the cleanest result, high-detail layer height and a structural infill that prevents any sagging or warping. Preferred colour is a uniform matte black, white, or grey. Dimensional accuracy should stay within ±0.2 mm across the entire piece. Once the print is finished, please handle basic post-processing (support removal, light cleanup), pack it securely, and ship to Kolkata, West Bengal. Include courier and packaging costs in your quote along with your estimated turnaround time. Deliverables • One full-scale print (no scaling) in the colour specified • Post-processed surface ready for light sanding and paint • Tracked shipment to my Kolkata address Acceptance will be based on fit to the supplied file, surface smoothness, and safe arrival. Share a few photos of previous prints that show similar finish quality when you respond. Looking forward to working together.

opportunities.title: Lead-Generating Mobile App
opportunities.description: I want to turn my concept into a polished mobile app whose single purpose is to attract new customers and prompt immediate enquiries. The finished product should make it effortless for prospects to learn what we offer, reach out in a tap, and keep coming back for more. Here’s the vision: a clean, modern interface that opens with a concise value statement, followed by clear calls-to-action such as tap-to-call, WhatsApp chat, or a short enquiry form. opportunities.title: Local Studio Ad Campaign
opportunities.description: I run Home Creative Studio in Mudabidri and I want everyone from here to Mangalore to know our name and place their orders with us first. My immediate priority is to push our Graphic design mattu video editing offerings, while also keeping Mehndi services visible to wedding families and making sure brides see our bridal full-hand designs loud and clear. What I need from you is a complete, practical advertising roll-out that speaks directly to Mangalore and Mudabidri brides, wedding families, and the local shops they frequent. The plan should cover online channels (Instagram Reels, Facebook, WhatsApp Status, short YouTube spots) and simple offline touches (in-store posters or table-top cards) that match our visual style. Please deliver: • A 3-month content calendar with post ideas, captions in simple Kannada/English mix, and target hashtags. • Five attention-grabbing static designs and two 15-second videos that showcase our Graphic design mattu video editing services first. • A mini-campaign for Mehndi aimed at wedding families that highlights bridal full-hand designs—one flyer, one reel, and one carousel post. • Clear guidance on local ad spend splits and boosting tactics so I can start the ads myself without guesswork. All artwork must be supplied in layered PSD/AI files plus ready-to-post JPG/MP4 versions. If this outline feels achievable and you can start right away, tell me how quickly you can turn around the first draft creatives.

opportunities.title: Engaging Indian Social Media Copy
opportunities.description: I run a consumer-focused brand in India and need a reliable copywriter who can keep my Instagram feed fresh with short, catchy captions and snappy post copy. Every piece you write should feel local, read naturally to an Indian audience, and showcase a clear, friendly tone that helps strengthen trust and overall brand awareness. The bulk of the work will be Instagram posts, though an ability to tweak copy for Facebook or LinkedIn later is a plus. Grammar must be spot-on, wording concise, and each caption should come with a simple, attention-grabbing hook and 1-2 relevant hashtags. Deliverables for every assignment • 1 caption (30–50 words) tailored to the brief • Suggested headline or first-line hook • Up to 2 hashtags that fit the Indian market I’ll supply the creative angle or product details; you return polished text within the mutually agreed deadline and stay available for quick clarifications on WhatsApp or email. Quick turnarounds, clear communication, and a genuine feel for Indian social media culture will make this collaboration smooth and long-term.

opportunities.title: Premium Lingerie Social Media Specialist - 20 hours p/week
opportunities.description: # Social Media Marketing Specialist — Premium Lingerie Brand | Active Brand Launch **Company:** Confidential — Emerging Premium Lingerie Brand **Location:** Remote **Contract Type:** Freelance — Long-Term Collaboration **Working Hours:** 20 Hours per Week **Industry:** Fashion, Lingerie, E-commerce & Dropshipping **Brand Stage:** Active Launch & Growth ## About the Brand We are a new international premium lingerie and intimate apparel brand entering the market. We are actively launching our brand and building our presence across Instagram, Facebook, and other relevant marketing channels. Our vision is to create a recognizable, elegant, and trusted brand with a premium visual identity, engaging social media content, and a growing customer community. **We are looking for someone who can start immediately and actively execute our social media marketing activities.** We need an experienced, creative, and detail-oriented **Social Media Marketing Specialist** who can personally create, edit, schedule, publish, and share professional content. **This is a hands-on, execution-focused position — not a management or strategy-only role.** You will work under the direction of our Brand Marketing Manager, who oversees marketing strategy, influencer partnerships, priorities, and performance. ## 1. Daily Instagram & Facebook Management You will be directly responsible for: - Creating, scheduling, and publishing Instagram and Facebook posts. - Designing and publishing Stories, Reels, carousel posts, and promotional content. - Sharing approved brand content across relevant channels. - Writing engaging captions in flawless English. - Selecting relevant hashtags and calls to action. - Maintaining a consistent publishing schedule. - Updating profile descriptions, highlights, and pinned posts. - Ensuring all published content is accurate and professionally formatted. - Keeping our social media accounts active, engaging, and visually consistent. - Implementing the marketing priorities established by the Brand Marketing Manager. **We expect daily execution and consistent output, not just ideas or recommendations.** ## 2. Social Media Creatives & Brand Visuals You will personally create and maintain our premium visual content. Responsibilities include: - Designing professional branded graphics. - Selecting, editing, and optimizing product photographs. - Creating attractive product-focused posts. - Designing carousel posts, Instagram Stories, and promotional creatives. - Creating short-form videos and Reels using available brand assets. - Maintaining consistent colors, typography, logo placement, and styling. - Developing reusable design templates. - Preparing visuals for product launches and marketing campaigns. - Organizing original design files and creative assets. - Identifying and improving low-quality marketing materials. - Following our official brand guidelines precisely. Experience with Canva, Adobe Photoshop, or comparable tools is required. AI-assisted creative tools may be used responsibly, but product details, colors, materials, and logos must remain accurate. **Professional visual quality, excellent attention to detail, and consistent branding are essential.** ## 3. Active Brand Launch & Growth Campaigns You will support the active launch and ongoing growth of our brand by: - Creating brand introduction and launch announcement posts. - Publishing product showcases and collection highlights. - Preparing launch promotions and campaign creatives. - Creating content that drives interest, engagement, and website visits. - Supporting influencer campaigns with approved content. - Producing product education and brand storytelling posts. - Developing engaging audience interaction content. - Preparing seasonal and promotional posts. - Maintaining consistent content production during launch campaigns. - Adjusting content based on performance and management feedback. Our priority is to establish a strong market presence while actively introducing and promoting our products. ## 4. Community Management & Customer Communication You will: - Monitor and respond to Facebook and Instagram comments. - Respond to customer messages through Facebook Messenger. - Manage Instagram direct messages where access is provided. - Answer approved product, sizing, availability, and shopping questions. - Maintain a professional, friendly, and consistent brand tone. - Encourage audience engagement and positive interactions. - Identify complaints and escalate sensitive issues. - Monitor spam and inappropriate comments. - Report recurring customer questions and feedback. Refunds, compensation, order changes, and policy exceptions require authorization. ## 5. Competitor Research & Content Improvement You will: - Research successful lingerie, fashion, and e-commerce brands. - Monitor competitor Instagram and Facebook content. - Identify successful content formats and trends. - Research promotional and product launch campaigns. - Collect relevant creative inspiration. - Recommend improvements to our social media presentation. - Share useful competitor findings with the Brand Marketing Manager. All creative work must remain original and aligned with our brand identity. ## 6. Content Planning & Organization You will: - Prepare a weekly social media content calendar. - Submit content for review and approval. - Schedule posts in advance. - Maintain organized creative files and content libraries. - Track completed and upcoming posts. - Implement feedback promptly. - Meet publishing deadlines. - Coordinate with the Brand Marketing Manager on campaigns and priorities. ## 7. opportunities.title: CNC Collision Detection AI Engine
opportunities.description: I need an AI engine that can open my CAM project files together with their 3D part, fixture and machine models, scan every programmed move, and flag any tool collision risks before a single chip is cut. The focus is solely on collisions with the machine, the fixture or the part; if the tool could crash, I want to know exactly where, when and why. The workflow I picture is straightforward: drop in the CAM file, let the AI analyse the toolpaths and geometry, then receive a clear, human-readable report plus a visual overlay that highlights the risky zones. A simple pass/fail headline is not enough—radius offsets, spindle positions and axis limits must all be considered so I can adjust the programme with confidence. Deliverables • A working collision-detection engine (library, plug-in, or stand-alone app) that accepts mainstream CAM formats and their associated 3D models. • A concise report output (JSON or CSV) and an optional 3D viewer/overlay showing collision points. • A sample dataset with at least three parts, each containing a confirmed collision, to demonstrate the engine’s accuracy and repeatability. • Brief setup notes or installer so I can reproduce your results on my workstation. Acceptance criteria • Detects every collision in the supplied test set and produces zero false positives on the provided clean paths. • Analysis completes within a practical timeframe for typical mould-making jobs (minutes, not hours). • Runs locally without requiring a live machine connection and without uploading proprietary geometry to third-party servers. If the core works well, I’m open to extending the system later to warn about air-cuts or sub-optimal feeds, but for this first phase collision detection is the entire mission.

opportunities.title: Asistente Telefónico Citas Belleza y Estética
opportunities.description: Busco un asistente remoto que atienda principalmente llamadas entrantes con el objetivo de agendar citas para mi centro de belleza y estética. Necesito una voz amable, organizada y capaz de transmitir confianza a cada cliente desde el primer “hola”. Responsabilidades clave • Responder llamadas en español con trato cercano y profesional. • Registrar nombre, servicio solicitado y datos de contacto de cada cliente. • Verificar disponibilidad y confirmar la cita en nuestro calendario online. • Enviar recordatorios breves por WhatsApp o correo cuando sea necesario. • Llevar un registro diario de llamadas atendidas y citas agendadas. Qué espero recibir de tu propuesta • Ejemplos concretos de tu trabajo anterior gestionando llamadas o agendas. • Breve descripción de las herramientas que utilizas (p. ej., Google Calendar, CRM, centralitas virtuales). • Tu disponibilidad horaria y zona horaria. Valoraré experiencia previa en recepción de spa, salones o centros estéticos, aunque no es imprescindible si demuestras habilidades telefónicas sólidas y atención al detalle. La colaboración iniciará de forma remota y puede convertirse en un acuerdo a largo plazo si encajamos bien. Espero tu propuesta.

opportunities.title: Bloqueo automático buzones Carbonio
opportunities.description: Trabajo con Carbonio CE 26.6.2 y debido a la eliminación de esta característica (limitación de tamaño de casillas) en la nueva versión, necesito automatizar el control de cuota de los buzones. Requiero un script ejecutado por cron (u otra alternativa que propongas) con las siguientes características: • Revisar periódicamente el tamaño de todos los buzones. • Aplicar un único límite global; al superarlo, la cuenta debe quedar impedida de enviar y recibir correos. • Mantener una whitelist configurable (por nombre de cuenta) que excluya determinadas casillas de la restricción. • Si un buzón bloqueado vuelve a quedar por debajo del límite, el sistema debe reactivar inmediatamente el envío y la recepción de mensajes. • Registrar en un log las acciones tomadas y, opcionalmente, enviar un resumen diario. • Entregar instrucciones claras de instalación, variables de configuración (límite en MB, ruta de la whitelist, frecuencia de ejecución) y comandos Carbonio/CLI empleados. Acepto propuestas o ideas nuevas que nos solucionen el problema, lo importante es que funcionen de forma fiable en la versión indicada. Al finalizar, espero el script completo, la guía de despliegue y una breve prueba de funcionamiento capturada en consola.

opportunities.title: Recomendaciones de productos de cocina
opportunities.description: Necesito un informe claro y objetivo que me ayude a elegir los mejores artículos de cocina y alimentación para el uso diario en mi hogar. Busco que investigues y selecciones varias opciones para cada categoría clave (por ejemplo, ollas, sartenes, utensilios, pequeños electrodomésticos y soluciones de almacenamiento de alimentos). Qué espero recibir: • Una lista curada de productos con 2-3 alternativas por categoría. • Ficha breve de cada artículo: precio promedio, ventajas, posibles desventajas y por qué lo recomiendas. • Enlaces directos a tiendas confiables donde puedan comprarse online (idealmente disponibles en mi país). • Comparativa resumida al final con tu veredicto general y consejos de compra. Valoro que tengas experiencia en investigación de mercado, reviews de productos y conocimiento actualizado sobre materiales libres de tóxicos, eficiencia energética y facilidad de limpieza. Si manejas herramientas como Google Shopping, Keepa o extensiones de seguimiento de precios, menciónalo porque suma valor. El tono del informe debe ser práctico y fácil de leer; no necesito redacción publicitaria, sino recomendaciones fundamentadas en datos y experiencia real de usuarios.

opportunities.title: DARV Shaadi Card Game Writer
opportunities.description: Hey Aahil bhai, ek project ke liye aapse baat karni thi. Maine aapka profile dekha aur aapka Hinglish + meme/comedy wala work relevant laga, isliye project properly explain kar raha hoon. Main ek 36-card Indian party/card game bana raha hoon — DARV: SHAADI EDITION. Basic idea: India already chaotic hai. Humne bas us chaos ko game bana diya. Mujhe normal comedy script, screenplay ya long dialogues bilkul nahi chahiye. Mujhe short, punchy aur playable card lines chahiye jo game ke time padhte hi log react karein. Humor ka vibe: * Proper Hinglish, jaise friends/cousins actually baat karte hain * Modern Indian + Gen-Z humor * Current Instagram/Reels/meme culture * Real Indian situations * Shaadi, relatives, cousins, baraat, food, photographer, family WhatsApp, school/college, aunty questions, awkward family moments etc. * Unexpected punchlines * Absurd situations * Meme references * Would You Rather * Character comedy * Internet/meme formats * Thoda savage/dark humor chalega, but overall fun/party-game friendly rehna chahiye Sabse important: mujhe 2019 Facebook/WhatsApp meme wali comedy nahi chahiye. Example of what I DON’T want: “When your Indian mom asks about your career ” Ye bahut basic hai. Mujhe aisa feel chahiye: “Bhai ye card kisne approve kiya ” Matlab joke padhke actual reaction aaye — “WHAT ” / “BHAI ” / “YE KYA THA” Aisa nahi lagna chahiye ki kisi professional writer ne joke likhne ki bahut koshish ki hai. It should feel like 3 cousins shaadi mein raat ke 11 baje bore hokar sabko observe kar rahe hain aur bakchodi kar rahe hain. ⸻ MAIN CARD MECHANIC — START → TWIST Game ka ek important format START → TWIST hoga. Player ko START pata hoga, but TWIST nahi pata hoga. Example: START: “Shaadi ke stage pe tumhe randomly bula liya gaya hai. Tumhe 10 seconds ki speech deni hai.” Player speech start karega. Then card reader TWIST reveal karega: TWIST: “Ab imagine karo audience mein tumhare school ke saare teachers baithe hain.” Basically player ko pata hi nahi hona chahiye ki agla kya hone wala hai. Twist predictable nahi hona chahiye — situation ko suddenly 10x zyada ridiculous bana de. ⸻ Cards ke aur formats: WOULD YOU RATHER Do aise options jahan dono choices funny/awkward hon. MEME / INTERNET CARDS Current meme formats, POVs, internet language, brainrot-type formats etc. use kar sakte hain. But meme ko copy nahi karna — format/reference ko Indian situation mein creatively convert karna hai. CHARACTER CARDS Foofa, pados wali aunty, over-smart cousin, photographer, family WhatsApp admin, food-obsessed cousin etc. CHAOS CARDS Random unexpected situation jisme player ko react/act/explain/defend karna pade. ⸻ Ek bahut important cheez: MEMES + CURRENT INTERNET HUMOUR + REAL-LIFE OBSERVATION ko priority dena. Mujhe overly polished “comedy writing” nahi chahiye. Human > Professional. Aap GPT/AI ka use brainstorming/reference ke liye freely kar sakte ho — situations brainstorm karne, meme formats explore karne, punchline ke different directions nikalne, joke ko less predictable banane etc. Main bhi GPT ke saath references/prompts share kar sakta hoon. But final cards original aur human-feeling hone chahiye, obvious AI-generated jokes nahi. ⸻ Total project Final deck = 36 cards Different formats mix honge: * Start → Twist * Would You Rather * Meme/Internet * Wedding chaos * Family/relative comedy * Character cards * Food/buffet * Wild/Unexpected cards Exact ratio hum gameplay ke hisaab se decide kar sakte hain. Mera focus sirf 36 lines complete karwana nahi hai. Mujhe genuinely FUN GAME banana hai. ⸻ Pehle full project nahi Main directly 36 cards ka order nahi karna chahta. Pehle 5-card paid test karte hain. Main aapko situations/brief dunga → aap 5 cards likhoge. Agar genuinely laga ki: “Haan bhai, ye banda DARV ki vibe samajh gaya.” then hum complete 36 cards pe continue karenge. Aur agar aapko kisi card ke liye idea/punchline direction chahiye ho toh GPT ko brainstorming/reference ke liye use karne mein koi issue nahi hai. Bas final output copied ya generic AI-type nahi hona chahiye. Agar aapko concept samajh aa gaya hai, batao. Main 5-card test ka proper brief bhej deta hoon.

opportunities.title: Closer Ventas Fitness Online
opportunities.description: Recibo todos los días contactos que dejan sus datos en un formulario después de ver mi anuncio de entrenamiento para perder peso. Necesito que tomes cada lead apenas entra en el CRM, le escribas, agendes una llamada rápida, profundices en sus objetivos y cierres la venta durante esa misma conversación telefónica. Las personas ya vienen convencidas de que necesitan bajar de peso; solo falta que alguien empático, directo y con buena energía les muestre cómo mi programa puede ayudarlas y concrete el pago. Por eso, tu principal métrica será la tasa de cierre y el tiempo que demores entre la entrada del lead y la llamada final. Uso habitual de WhatsApp, teléfono o Zoom (lo que el prospecto prefiera) y registro de todas las interacciones en el mismo CRM para poder medir tu rendimiento con claridad. Entrego acceso al guion base, testimonio de clientes y oferta detallada. Tú aportas habilidades de comunicación, control de objeciones y seguimiento hasta que el prospecto se convierta en alumno activo.

opportunities.title: Diseño App Nutricionista Móvil
opportunities.description: Necesito un diseño de aplicación pensado específicamente para nutricionistas que les permita crear y enviar planes de alimentación personalizados a cada paciente. Lo esencial es contar con pantallas intuitivas donde el profesional pueda armar menús y recetas adaptadas, asignarlas al paciente y compartirlas de forma clara y atractiva. Alcance • Arquitectura de pantallas principales (login, panel del profesional, ficha del paciente, editor de menús/recetas, vista de plan del paciente y centro de mensajes). • Prototipo interactivo para iOS y Android en Figma o una herramienta equivalente, con flujo completo desde la creación del plan hasta el envío. • Guía de estilos (tipografías, paleta, iconografía y componentes reutilizables) para conservar coherencia en futuras iteraciones. Entregables mínimos 1. Wireframes de baja fidelidad validados conmigo. 2. Mock-ups de alta fidelidad y prototipo navegable. 3. Archivo maestro editable + assets exportables (.svg/.png). Criterios de aceptación – El editor de menús debe permitir añadir o modificar recetas por paciente de manera dinámica. – El plan debe poder visualizarse con una jerarquía clara (desayuno, almuerzo, cena, colaciones) y opción de compartir en un solo toque. – Interfaz simple, accesible y con buenas prácticas de UX para profesionales de la salud. Qué espero en tu propuesta Explícame tu proceso, tiempos y qué herramientas utilizarás; incluye un desglose de hitos y ejemplos de trabajos similares. Solo revisaré propuestas que traigan este nivel de detalle. Estoy abierto a sugerencias sobre funcionalidades secundarias como seguimiento de progreso o recordatorios, pero su inclusión no forma parte del alcance inmediato; prefiero centrar el esfuerzo de esta fase en la creación y envío de planes.

Lo esencial es contar con pantallas intuitivas donde el profesional pueda armar menús y recetas adaptadas, asignarlas al paciente y compartirlas de forma clara y atractiva. Alcance • Arquitectura de pantallas principales (login, panel del profesional, ficha del paciente, editor de menús/recetas, vista de plan del paciente y centro de mensajes). • Prototipo interactivo para iOS y Android en Figma o una herramienta equivalente, con flujo completo desde la creación del plan hasta el envío. • Guía de estilos (tipografías, paleta, iconografía y componentes reutilizables) para conservar coherencia en futuras iteraciones. Entregables mínimos 1. Wireframes de baja fidelidad validados conmigo. 2. Mock-ups de alta fidelidad y prototipo navegable. 3. Archivo maestro editable + assets exportables (.svg/.png). Criterios de aceptación – El editor de menús debe permitir añadir o modificar recetas por paciente de manera dinámica. – El plan debe poder visualizarse con una jerarquía clara (desayuno, almuerzo, cena, colaciones) y opción de compartir en un solo toque. – Interfaz simple, accesible y con buenas prácticas de UX para profesionales de la salud. Qué espero en tu propuesta Explícame tu proceso, tiempos y qué herramientas utilizarás; incluye un desglose de hitos y ejemplos de trabajos similares. Solo revisaré propuestas que traigan este nivel de detalle. Estoy abierto a sugerencias sobre funcionalidades secundarias como seguimiento de progreso o recordatorios, pero su inclusión no forma parte del alcance inmediato; prefiero centrar el esfuerzo de esta fase en la creación y envío de planes."

proposal.body:
¡Hola Solicitante Anuncio #40782902 (Tareas en Español)! 👋 Revisé la solicitud exacta de **"Diseño App Nutricionista Móvil"** y cumplo con los requisitos para iniciar de inmediato.

Realizo **bioconstrucción en guadua, muro tendinoso con botellas y vidrio, todo tipo de cubiertas y estructuras en metal/soldadura, secaderos de café, murales artísticos, modelado 3D en Blender y planos**.

📲 Contacto directo en San Agustín, Huila (Colombia): **+57 322 273 9034**.
